races.name: A Place For You Here Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: TIGRESS LILLY could be poised to go one better following a much-improved second here last time. The Bowen brothers are well represented with Gortmore Lady and Forest Spirit respectively, while Chief Sunday would be interesting if supported.
